captions: 5:50 a.m., halfway up. A job offer in another city.
You asked Google. Then Reddit. Then nine friends.
Nine opinions. Nine directions. Still lost.
At the top, the sun breaks through the clouds.
So big. So quiet. And you realise who you never asked.
You raise your hands. Your voice shakes.
That afternoon: two rak’ahs. Then the du’a of istikhara.
No lightning. No dream. Just a heart that’s calm again.
Whatever He chooses, you’re no longer choosing alone.

post.caption:
46 searches about one decision. Not one question to Allah. ⛰️

A job offer in another city. You asked Google, Reddit, nine friends — nine opinions, nine directions, still lost. Then, at the top of the mountain, you finally ask the One who knows.

“Call upon Me; I will respond to you.” (40:60)

This afternoon: two rak’ahs of istikhara. Then ask Him.
